obituaries.full_text:
Survivors: He was survived by five children: Patricia Ann and husband Larry 
 Wells, John Wallace Greenage Jr. and fiance Elizabeth Clarkson., Evelyn Best, 
 Jacqueline and husband Boyd Gannon Jr., and Christopher Greenage and fiance 
 Victoria Py. He was survived by 12 grandchildren and five great grandchildren. 
 Brothers; William and Robert Greenage. Sister; Mrs. Jeanne Jacoby.
